qiaomu-reader-dsh.description: Remove the empty-selection hint and its Chinese/English messages; hide sorting during selection while retaining the order and narrow-screen format filtering. Add bilingual selection-state tests and use fileURLToPath in the affected test renderer. README documents selection mode. Only client.js changes among built artifacts in this UI update; index.js already includes the batch-import and tag changes from commits 37c1cc9 and 893c40d.
qiaomu-reader-dsh.documentRename: Host-confirmed display-title editing for stored EPUB/PDF/TXT, with first original title retained across identical-content imports. Starter and browser-only books are excluded; Host and Client artifacts are rebuilt. Persistence, cache and bilingual dialog regressions cover the change.
qiaomu-reader-dsh.imagePagination: EPUB images fit the measured page and column before page counting; temporary inline size overrides restore in scroll mode. Multi-image containers remain fragmentable. Reader effects, image size restoration and real Chromium multi-image checks cover the change; client.js is rebuilt, Host remains unchanged.

dsh-better-sidebar.description: Source-only local copy. Replace webRuntime with Host Connection requestRejection, preserve 401/403, add admission tests and current terminal labels. Remove imported/new scripts and generated artifacts; retain source, tests, configuration, documentation, assets and license.

dsh-pet.description: Sync the vendored pet plugin to upstream v0.3.8 and keep exactly one behavioural customization: double-clicking the pet body brings the DSH Desktop window back to the foreground. The double-click reuses the upstream pet:open-site channel (dsh://open in the desktop host) instead of the previous custom IPC chain, and the click listener gained a detail guard so the second click of a double-click no longer re-plays the click animation. The former Windows native foreground chain (desktop-activation.js, windows-activation.js, src/host/window-activation.ts, the /dsh-pet-7340/activate-desktop bridge route and the koffi optional dependency) was removed.
dsh-pet.doubleClickOpenDesktop: runtime/electron-helper/sprite.js: click listener guarded with e.detail < 2; dblclick bound to onOpenDsh(), which defers to window.petBridge.openDshSite(ORIGIN) and bails out while dragging or within the post-drag justDragged cooldown so the slingshot gesture keeps working.

note: Hashes cover copied upstream files and the current locally modified files identified in localModifications. Original hashes for those local modifications are retained separately. Hand-edited manifests, metadata locales, build scripts, icons, README files and unlisted tests are excluded, as is the symlink plugins/qiaomu-reader/src/client/ui, which has no content hash.
